caveats: ⚑ skill1 cadence INVENTED: the kit line carries no activation clause, so it is modeled as an interval trigger at an unmeasured 10s. Every skill1 damage number scales linearly with this guess.
⚑ skill2 Pierce window is a ROUND count (2 rounds) but gainPierce has no round-count field; the 2.4s durationSec is a shots→seconds conversion off an unmeasured SG cadence.
⚑ Hit Rate ▲22.04% → core-rate lift goes through the engine's hrCoreMult derivation; the damage magnitude of the conversion is unmeasured for this unit.
⚑ SG pellet split-vs-merge (hitsPerShot 10) is kit-silent and left to the engine's SG landing path; not verified against popups.
noFb deliberately NOT set on the skill1 rider (FB-by-timing default ON) — noFb is measurement-only.
The skill2 ATK buff is keyed to fullBurstEnter (any team Full Burst) per the literal activation text, NOT to Neve's own burst cast.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Neve (SG/Water/Attacker/B3, cd 40s, ammo 9, hitsPerShot 10) is modeled as: S1 a single-target 145.45%-of-final-ATK rider on an invented 10s interval (the kit line states no trigger); S2 a Full-Burst-entry self package — Pierce plus ATK ▲124.8%, both bounded by a 2-ROUND count (the ATK buff uses durationShots:2, one round = one SG trigger pull, so it survives at most two shots and can span a reload); burst a pure self-buff cast with Critical Rate ▲31.95% and Hit Rate ▲22.04% for 20s, no burst damage component. The S1 rider is crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate and takes no core (the text says plain damage, not core strike) and no range bonus (engine-automatic). Pierce is windowed via a gainPierce effect rather than the whole-fight hasPierce flag, since the kit grants it only inside the post-FB-entry round window.

audit.kitLine: Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with lowest HP
audit.effectOrReason: Single-target selection clause; the scope-lock fight has exactly one boss, so target resolution is degenerate. Block authored with target self (the caster is the damage source; resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [] in this engine).

audit.kitLine: Deals 145.45% of final ATK as damage.
audit.effectOrReason: flatDamage atkPct 145.45, crit:true (rider crits at caster sheet rate), no core (text says plain damage), noRange engine-automatic, noFb unset so it takes Full Burst by landing timing. ⚑ trigger/cadence invented — see flags.
trigger {kind:'fullBurstEnter'} — literal 'entering Full Burst' text, so it fires on ANY team Full Burst, not only rotations where Neve casts. Not re-keyed to burstCast.
gainPierce effect (NOT the top-level hasPierce flag — the grant is a bounded window, not whole-fight). ⚑ round-count → durationSec 2.4 conversion, unmeasured.

buff atkPct 124.8 with durationShots:2 (ROUND count, not seconds; a round is one SG trigger pull, not one of the 10 pellets). No durationSec, so the window can span a reload exactly as the kit states.
target {kind:'self'}, trigger burstCast (self-mode buffs in the unit's own burst block fire only on rotations Neve bursts).
buff critRatePct 31.95, durationSec 20. Unscoped in the kit text (no 'of normal attacks' qualifier), so generic critRatePct — NOT critRateNormalPct.
buff hitRatePct 22.04, durationSec 20 — routed through the engine's Hit-Rate→core-lift path. ⚑ magnitude of the conversion is measured-only.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the S1 damage line carries NO activation clause at all, so both the trigger KIND and its period are invented. Per the methodology, a clause-free damage line defaults to `interval`; 10s is a mid-range guess for a single-target Attacker skill and the whole S1 contribution scales linearly with it (18 procs at 10s vs 12 at 15s over a 180s fight).
flags.recipe: Read the datamined skillCooldownsSec entry for neve in data/ and set sec to it. Cross-check by counting 145.45%-magnitude popups attributable to Neve in a recorded fight (expected count = 180/sec) and confirm the first-fire phase (t=sec vs t=0 — the interval convention is first fire at t=sec).

flags.reasoning: The kit bounds Pierce by a ROUND count, but gainPierce exposes only durationSec (no durationShots). 2.4s assumes ~0.83 pulls/s for the SG; leaving durationSec absent would make Pierce continuous for the whole fight, a large over-credit whenever a Pierce Damage ▲ source is in the team.
flags.recipe: Compute 2 / (effective SG pulls per second) from the engine's cadence table for neve (effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal rate_of_fire)) and set durationSec to that; better, add a round-count field to gainPierce so the window is expressed natively and stretches across reloads like the co-located ATK buff does.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and here they are load-bearing twice over — they set the shot economy AND the real length of both 2-round windows in skill2 (a faster cadence shrinks the ATK ▲124.8% window, a slower one stretches it).
flags.recipe: Read shots/sec directly off the in-fight ammo counter (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), not off full-burst counts; time a full 9→0→9 magazine cycle for the reload figure.

flags.estimate: 22.04 kit value, engine hrCoreMult conversion unverified for this unit
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #7: the kit percentage is exact, but the Hit-Rate→core-rate mapping is a derived engine relationship. On a 10-pellet SG the core-rate lift is the single largest damage lever in this kit's burst, so an error in the conversion dominates Neve's burst-window numbers.
flags.recipe: A/B a recorded fight with HRCORE=0 vs default and compare Neve's core-hit fraction over the 20s post-burst window against the CORE-HIT popup count; the accuracy-circle geometry in docs/data/sg-calc/ is the ground truth for the mapping.

flags.estimate: engine default SG per-pellet landing path
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #5: kit-silent. How the 10 pellets split (and whether any consolidation applies) is not stated in the prose and must be read off popups; it also decides whether 'round' in the 2-round windows could be misread as 10.
flags.recipe: Count distinct damage popups per trigger pull in footage; confirm the round-count buffs decrement once per pull (not 10×) via a buffApply/durationShots trace in a harness run.

flags.estimate: unset (Full Burst applies by landing timing)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF. Setting it blind would silently strip the +50% major from every S1 proc that lands inside a Full Burst window.
flags.recipe: Compare the S1 popup magnitude inside vs outside a Full Burst window in a recording; a flat ratio of 1.50 confirms noFb should stay unset, a ratio of 1.00 justifies setting it.
